sources.title: Llama3.1-8B-Instruct: Architecture & Adaptation
sources.snippet: Llama3.1-8B-Instruct is an 8-billion-parameter instruction-tuned LLM based on Meta's Llama 3 architecture. It has become a central foundation in open-source research, both as a baseline and as a substrate for advanced alignment, reasoning, and fine-tuning methodologies.
